title: TKDL Classical Formulation Prior Art - Haridra (Turmeric) Formulations

sections.content: Use of Haridra (Curcuma longa) in combination with Maricha (Piper nigrum) for inflammatory and metabolic disorders documented in Charaka Samhita Chikitsasthana 16/39-42 and Astanga Hridaya. Prior art citation under Indian Patents Act Sec 3(p).
